claims.quote: DEPDC5, the first gene for nonlesional focal epilepsy likely to be relevant to sporadic patients with focal epilepsies and those from small families, in contrast to rare large families with autosomal dominant focal epilepsies.
As DEPDC5 is a negative regulator of the mammalian target of rapamycin (mTOR) pathway
it is likely that some patients with DEPDC5 mutations may have malformations of cortical development
